4050-6277-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4574-4659-6900-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
4574-4659-6900-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

891-6798-8207.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

141-1854-5686.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-5686.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha, creating a Blood token.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-7730-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-3478-7892.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil the Strategist, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1497-2523-2869.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Wild Cantor that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Wild Cantor token

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

206-3259-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
206-3259-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

5256-6351-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

539-2921-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-1482-2608.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Jeweled Lotus.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3734-4375-5315.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

2457-3499-4289-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Frog and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Frog and Insect by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3259-5484-6791.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5484-6791.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

851-5658-6245-6753.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
851-5658-6245-6753.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
851-5658-6245-6753.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

2275-3591-5437-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2275-3591-5437-6282.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control with power 5 or greater that does not have summoning sickness

3750-5231-6525.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
3750-5231-6525.description:
Declare the creature that has Infantry Shield attached as an attacker. The creature triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking equal to the creature's power.
During your postcombat main phase, activate Thermopod five times by sacrificing five Warriors, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

855-2060-4893-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
855-2060-4893-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2440-2714-4055-5105.description:
Cast Siege-Gang Commander by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Siege-Gang Commander enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander trigger, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
When the Goblin tokens enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers three times.
Resolve all four Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {16}.
Activate Energy Refractor four times by paying {8}, adding {W}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Siege-Gang Commander by paying {C}{R} and sacrificing itself.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {C}{W} to return Siege-Gang Commander from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Siege-Gang Commander activated ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1641-2034-4055-4192.notablePrerequisites: "Spirit" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
1641-2034-4055-4192.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

2667-3718.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
2667-3718.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Witherbloom Pledgemage triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Chain of Acid, destroying nothing and causing you to copy Chain of Acid, targeting an indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Repeat from step 2.

2068-2173-2544.notablePrerequisites:
Each opponent's life total is no greater than 40.
You control at least 18 other nonland permanents.
2068-2173-2544.description:
Activate Bolas's Citadel by tapping it and sacrificing ten other nonland permanents you control.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bolas's Citadel's ability.
Resolve both Bolas's Citadel abilities, causing each opponent to lose 20 life.
Each opponent that had 20 or less life loses the game due to having 0 or less life.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Bolas's Citadel.
Activate Bolas's Citadel by tapping it and sacrificing itself, Manifold Key, and eight other nonland permanents you control.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Bolas's Citadel's ability.
Resolve both Bolas's Citadel abilities, causing each opponent to lose 20 life.
Each remaining opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

4116-4367.notablePrerequisites:
Akki Battle Squad has at least one counter on it.
You control a modified creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a modified creature that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
4116-4367.description:
During your combat phase, activate a modified creature you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Akki Battle Squad until your next turn.
Declare any modified creature you control as an attacker.
Volrath triggers, untapping all modified creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1303-1409-2743-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Biovisionary.
"Zombie" chosen with Conspiracy.
1303-1409-2743-4875.description:
Activate Biovisionary by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Biovisionary enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator and Necroduality.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing itself and Biovisionary.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Repeat steps 1-4 two additional times.
At the beginning of your end step, Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3075-3940.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three experience counters.
392-3075-3940.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}.
Birgi and Haze of Rage's Storm ability trigger.
Resolve Birgi's ability, adding {R}.
Resolve Haze of Rage's ability, copying Haze of Rage for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all copies of Haze of Rage, giving creatures you control +1/+0 until end of turn for each copy and returning the original Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

804-2724-3217.description:
Cast Sakashima for {2}{U}{U}, entering as a copy of Wormfang Manta.
Pay {2}{U}{U} to return it to your hand, triggering Wormfang Manta's LTB, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Repeat for infinite turns.
